title: Every reading stored dated with its source; latest entered is current
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on for the shop (it ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. An asset exists that has a mileage and engine-hours history (e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
  3. Open the asset's Maintenance tab; a work order carrying the same asset is also available.
custom_steps:
1. Enter readings from different sources (from the asset, and from a work order).
  2. Open the reading history.
  3. Enter a value lower than the last one and save.
  4. Check the current reading and the history.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every change to mileage or engine hours is stored as a dated reading with its source (work order, asset, customer portal, import or API).
  • The last value entered is the current reading, even when it is lower.
  • A lower value is flagged, and both the lower and the previous value stay in history.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10567 (S10, Enter a reading); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 2 / S10; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R10: “Every change to an asset's mileage or engine hours is stored as a dated reading with its source: work order, asset, customer portal, import or API. A value on an open work order shows In the shop until that work order is invoiced, per S10-R11. The last value entered is the current reading, even when it is lower; a lower value is flagged and both stay in history”
  • S10-N3: “A value lower than the last one saves, is flagged, and both values stay in history”
